tldr: This note asks for the sharp sequential and report-conditioned batch finite-SATE minimax precision surfaces when both the fixed reporting-error cap and the factual gold budget grow as \(\sqrt n\). The exact signed symmetry and count identities provide supporting reductions. The inherited clean benchmark gives \(V_j(n,b,\lambda)\ge\rho_n\) and exact zero-error equality, with \(\rho_n=n^{-1}-C_A n^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3})\). The finite-grid posterior-state menu and directed-error ledger specify a candidate route toward attaining original-record procedures and certified evaluation; termination and matching certificates remain open. No sharp positive-error value or global feedback phase is established. The cap has a concrete certification interpretation on a fully replayable benchmark; ordinary clinical potential outcomes motivate only conditional sensitivity use.
gap: Published surrogate-assisted coding results optimize a prescribed unbiased residual estimator, while adaptive audit results chiefly certify coverage or testing error. Neither evaluates sharp causal minimax MSE with a fixed both-potential error envelope, scarce factual gold outcomes and unrestricted competing treatment and audit laws.
